result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a last category chip is clipped, a restaurant name is truncated in the horizontal list, and the bottom popular card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last category filter chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so users cannot see the full label or tell there are more categories.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and allow the chips row to scroll with a visible overflow hint so every chip is fully readable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated on the third 'Fastest near you' card, and the card itself is clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Give cards enough width or allow wrapping/ellipsis with a scrollable row so names and images are not cut off.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.
